## About Me

I'm a MUSA student at Penn. My background is in urban planning and design.

I grew up to love everything about cities thanks to my upbringing in Sunny Singapore, and I aspire to use data to help make places more seamless and sustainable!

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

## Skills

* Spatial analysis, GIS, data visualisation, urban design, quantitative methods.

* **Tools:** QGIS; R; Python; Adobe Suite; Google Earth Engine; Stata

:::
